READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 1 word on each page, so there is no text layer; the page is a single JPEG2000 bitmap of 1113x1444 px (~125 dpi) which was extracted, rotated 90 degrees upright and read at 2x and 3x -- at that size every digit separates. TEN COLUMNS, NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER AND NOT INFERRED (rule 13b.4), left to right: BEGINNING MARKET VALUE, BEGINNING PRINCIPAL, BEGINNING EARNINGS, NET EARNINGS, TRANSFERS OF PRINCIPAL, TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS, ENDING CASH VALUE, CHANGE IN UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS, UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS, ENDING MARKET VALUE; every one is headed `FY 2020`. The two pages carry SIX groups -- CEMETERY (3 funds), CONSERVATION (5), LIBRARY (14), SCHOLARSHIP (13, spanning both pages), MISCELLANEOUS (5) and STABILIZATION (4) -- each with its own printed SUBTOTALS line, under a printed GRAND TOTALS. Each group is read as its own group and footed to its own subtotal; the GRAND TOTALS line is proved separately against the six subtotals in `fy2020-p41-trust-grand-totals.csv`. ACROSS THE TWO PAGES 214 INDEPENDENT ASSERTIONS CLOSE TO THE CENT: 44 funds x 3 row identities, 6 groups x 10 column subtotals, 10 grand-total columns, and the 'held by other banks' table's own 5 columns and 10 row identities. ONE row does not, and it is the DOCUMENT: see the scholarship group. The handoff recorded this year's trust grand total as $7.00 -- that was recognition, and the page prints $3,075,973.52 / $3,408,354.62. THIS FILE IS THE GRAND TOTALS LINE ITSELF: its six `fund` rows are the six printed SUBTOTALS lines, added down against the printed GRAND TOTALS on p41. All ten columns close to the cent. No row identity is declared here because a SUBTOTALS line is not a fund and states none.
